result: If I could change the world in one way, I would make empathy as immediate and undeniable as physical sensation—so that causing harm to another felt unnatural, and understanding someone else’s suffering wasn’t a choice but a reflex. It wouldn’t erase difference or conflict, but it would make cruelty much harder to sustain.
